preconditions.description: The number of forbidden values n and modulus m satisfy 0 <= n < m <= 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(forbidden) == n and all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden) and len(set(forbidden)) == n
preconditions.description: The forbidden list contains exactly n distinct integers, each between 0 and m-1.

postconditions.description: The printed length k equals the number of elements in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in seq)
postconditions.description: Every element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and m-1 inclusive.
All prefix products modulo m are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(p not in forbidden for p in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears in the forbidden list.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(0 <= x < m for x in cand) and len(set(cand_prefix)) == len(cand) and all(p not in forbidden for p in cand_prefix) for cand in (candidate_sequences(k + 1)))
postconditions.description: The sequence length k is maximal; no valid sequence of length k+1 exists.
